# The settings screen in the smallest window any GUI scale gives (1280x720 at GUI scale 4 = 320x180): the footer
# buttons (Reset all must stop before Done) and the Preview hint (it wraps onto more lines instead of running off the
# sides), in Russian and German, then the hint at GUI scale 2 in English (one line, where it always was).
# Run it: gh workflow run screenshots.yml --ref main -f version=1.21.11 -f mod_ref=<branch> -f script=.github/checks/settings-small.txt

cmd time set noon
look 0 -20
sleep 6
lang ru_ru
sleep 15
guiscale 4
gui 0
sleep 3
shot settings-small-ru
preview
sleep 2
shot settings-preview-ru
close
lang de_de
sleep 15
gui 0
sleep 3
shot settings-small-de
preview
sleep 2
shot settings-preview-de
close
lang en_us
sleep 15
guiscale 2
gui 0
sleep 3
preview
sleep 2
shot settings-preview-en-g2
close
